name: Prestige Reset
description: Trading everything you have for going faster next time. Prestige converts current progress into a meta-currency by a declared curve, wipes the layers marked resettable, and leaves the rest standing — and which layers are which is the entire design of an incremental game, so it is an input rather than a convention. The conversion is previewable before it is committed: a player who cannot see what a reset buys is being asked to gamble their save, and the genre's whole appeal is that the maths is visible. Multipliers earned this way are permanent and stack additively by default, because a multiplicative stack makes the third prestige trivial and the tenth meaningless.

inputs.name: conversionCurve
inputs.description: How lifetime earnings become meta-currency. 'sqrt' is the genre default: generous early, punishing to farm.

inputs.name: resetLayers
inputs.description: Which layers a prestige wipes. Anything absent survives, which is how permanent progress is expressed.

inputs.name: minimumEarningsToPrestige
inputs.description: Floor below which prestige is refused, so the first one lands after a real run.

inputs.name: multiplierStacking
inputs.description: How permanent multipliers combine. Additive keeps the tenth prestige meaningful.

outputs.name: previewGain
outputs.description: What a reset would grant right now.
